BREAKING: Samsung reportedly plans to make chips for SpaceX’s Starlink satellites in Austin, Texas. 

Samsung is investing $1.9 billion to expand its Austin chip factory, with the planned operations targeted to begin by 2030, according to Seoul Economic Daily.

The chip, called STM32V8, is already used in Starlink’s mini laser system. SpaceX’s Starlink engineering team has praised the chip’s performance.

The chips are currently manufactured in France. The reported Texas plan would add American production capacity for a key component behind Starlink’s satellite communications.

text:
I'm traveling across US on motorcycle, to explore a country I love and to meet people from all walks of life, especially in rural America, and learn about their life story, philosophy, and just celebrate their humanity. I'm about 1,000 miles in.

I know my mom will surely kill me when she reads this. So, mom, please don't worry, everything will be great 🙏❤️

Btw, I still need to publish videos on my trip through China, where I hitchhiked about 3,000km across rural China, also interviewed some of the top AI & robotics folks there. I'll do that soon.

I'm just slow with the editing thing & bad at the filming thing. I'll try to get better. Mostly, when I travel, I focus on taking it all in and being present with the people in front of me, learning from them, while allocating no thought to the camera. The camera is a side thing I bring along sometimes because it's nice to relive those moments & to share with others.

Anyway, I'll probably take breaks from the road on occassion (to do podcasts, etc). But the goal is to eventually crisscross the country. Who knows how far I'll actually get.

And to friends who will surely write me "wtf are you doing you idiot", please don't worry, while it's true that I'm kind of an idiot, I will also make sure to be safe. Exploring the country on a motorcycle is unlike anything else, it's freedom. It makes me love this country even more: its beautiful nature and all the variety of characters who make up America. And of course, I'm trying to stay off of the interstate, taking as many backroads as I can.

I'll post video if/when I get to it. Sorry to be slow.

Love you all ❤️

Here's a quickly drawn map of current plan, but it changes daily, and so far I've taken basically every random detour & side quest I've come across 😂 Advice appreciated. I'm staying southern US for the winter. I'm hoping to end up in California by February. And then maybe switch over to Europe & Asia until August, and then switch back to finish US. But all such silly plans change on the daily, including for big podcasts, so who knows... I might film some or none of it.

As an introvert, I've been hiding from world too much, taking in too much internet & AI, and I think it's important to just go, get out there into the full beautiful mess of the real world, in rural America & other countries, and get to know all kinds of people... But who knows I might get stuck somewhere in the best way, fall in love, get married, and laugh at this post in retrospect 😂 Life awaits...

text: The sleeper is the Decisions API. gemini-decision-1 scores yes/no, choice, and rubric questions in one pass, $0.10 per 1M input, $0 output. OpenAI already ships this idea. Google adds audio, video, PDFs, and 1,000 questions. No caching yet.

Practical move: put Decisions in front as a router, Hydrogen in the loop, Carbon only on the hard pass. Burn the Carbon intro price before Dec 1. Don't blindly leave 3.8 Flash until you've measured cost per task. Flash is still cheaper per token through Dec 31.
